summary: Revised implementation plan for fixing the Policy & Leech Calibration modal scroll bleed and dynamic multi-country Spanish localization (ensuring {countryName} is 100% dynamic for any nation), integrating official WarEra country flags (flagcdn.com), and integrating all official WarEra item & equipment icons (media.warera.io). Includes 3 comparative architectural proposals, edge case mitigations, and tiered phased task decomposition.
